summary.text: Justin Busch is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 16, which covers Whitley County and a portion of Allen County, since 2018.
He is the ranking member of the Health and Provider Services Committee and is vice president of Fort Wayne Garmong Construction.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Busch earned bachelor's degrees in interpersonal and organizational communication and in history from Indiana University-Purdue University Fort Wayne and attended Carroll High School.

He is a former vice president of the Allen County Council, a former gubernatorial appointee to the Indiana Real Estate Commission, a former appointee to the Allen County Alcoholic Beverage Commission, a former appointee in the George W. Bush administration and a former White House intern.
He also serves on the Environmental Affairs and Public Policy committees.
The page lists him as immediate past president of the Indiana University Alumni Association's Northeast Indiana Chapter and a board member of Brightpoint.
